name: Steamed Wide Rice Noodles (Ho Fun with Tamari & Sesame)
whyItWorks: Steamed wide flat sheets of white rice noodles. Soft, slippery, and gentle, requiring almost no mechanical digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam fresh ho fun noodles or simmer briefly in broth until soft and slippery. Toss with a splash of tamari and toasted sesame oil.
